next.reason: Same. 1985 compares each control item with its saved prior content by the inequality relation test: numeric, index or nonnumeric comparison by the item's kind. 2023 §2023:13.18.16.4 GR3 saves each control item in a prior control 'having the same data description' and tests the current value 'for equality with the corresponding prior control'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR3 makes each GENERATE save and compare them. Comparing an item's value with a like-described copy is the numeric comparison for a numeric item, the index comparison for an index item and the character comparison otherwise, so a 1985 report breaks on the same records. The refuter's UNSURE (2023 does not name the relation rules) finds no case with a different result.
